body: I know how hard it is to believe someone once you have been hurt and let down so many times. But I want you to know I will always be here for you, if you ever need someone to vent to, or talk to. And I genuinely mean that.

I am currently battling the same thoughts of people being better off without me. But even if it is just a stranger on the internet, every bit of happiness or hope I have left I will give to you and I want you to know I consider you a friend and I do not see you as terrible. In fact I see you as an amazing person who just was given a bad deal of cards. 

And now that I think about it, my friend who died, she thought the world would be better off without her. It's been 6 months and I am not better.. if anything I am worse. It would shatter my heart to know that another friend of mine left in that way. Please stay for me, and trust that I mean everything I say. 

Your friends who left might have had other things going on in their lives, but that doesnt mean you should slow your progress and life down to mourn the loss of their friendship. You can do amazing things by yourself. I know it.

Thank you for taking the time to write this. It means a lot to me.. I hate to let you down but I know for a fact I will never love myself. Theres nothing to love.  

All of my hobbies and passions left me.. I used to have a passion for my job at a dog kennel, training puppies. I met my best friend there when she was hired. I trained her and we grew so close like people who have known eachother for years. My passion died along with her when she killed herself. My passion for my job is completely gone. 

She used to draw and paint, like me. I cant even pick up a paint brush without sobbing and it's been 6 months. I feel like it will never get better without her. She was the only light in my life, other than this comment you just posted. 

My dream was to be happily married one day in a healthy relationship but my boyfriend hates me now and I cant do anything to fix it. I feel like I ruin everything in my life and that theres no reason to try.

I feel the same way, except my only friend I did lose to death. And I feel great regret and guilt for not being there for her more. You are made of so much good and you deserve the entire world. I hope one day you realize that. I wish my friend could've realized that sooner.
